qa_pairs.question: What should an Alliance wiki contributor do if they encounter a lone translation tag at the end of a section's wikicode while making an edit?
qa_pairs.answer: If a contributor finds a lone translation tag at the end of a section's wikicode, they should stop editing that section. They should then copy any edits they've made into a local text editor, cancel their changes in the wikicode editor, and instead begin editing the wikicode of the entire page.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure for marking changes on an already translated Alliance wiki page so that the new content can be translated?
qa_pairs.answer: To mark changes on an already translated page, first ensure the page is stable and do not manually alter automatically generated translation tags (e.g., `<!--T:3-->`). After making your edits, new text intended for translation must be enclosed within `<translate> </translate>` tags, while code blocks and wiki markup should be excluded from translation using `</translate> <translate>` tags. Next, go into 'View' mode and click the 'marked for translation' link that appears at the top of the page. Review the translation units, confirm 'fr' or 'en' as the priority language, and then click 'Mark this version for translation'.

qa_pairs.question: Why are code blocks typically not translated on the Alliance wiki, and what are the recommended methods for conveying information from comments within these blocks to users reading translated pages?
qa_pairs.answer: Code blocks are typically not translated on the Alliance wiki because professional human translators may struggle to differentiate between code and comments across various programming languages. To ensure explanatory comments are still accessible to users reading translated pages, contributors are advised to move the information from comments into the surrounding text, which will be translated. Alternatively, they can use index comments (e.g., 'NOTE 1') to link external, translated text to specific lines of code. Bilingual contributors familiar with the translation apparatus may also choose to translate the code block themselves.
